title: Emergency Translation App
scenario: A stranger says you must install an app to communicate with police or staff.

answers.A: Install the app from the stranger link and grant every permission.
answers.B: Install it but deny the camera and contacts permissions.
answers.C: Use a trusted translation app from the official app store.
answers.D: Ask hotel or official staff to provide another communication route.

explanation: A stressful situation makes an unknown app feel necessary. Use a trusted tool or official staff and limit permissions.
proTip: Emergency does not mean every app deserves access.
